nativePressureControlComparison.strategy: Maintain each commissioned manifold pressure in both 96 and128 states, with fixed other-room branches and kitchen two-position regulator/hood. Equal target pressures do not guarantee equal downstream branch flows when shared losses change.

failureResponseComparison.baseline: Electric/no-combustion programme; no gas-appliance interlock is inferred.
failureResponseComparison.visibleManualComparison: Native GC10/app displays unit alarms, including E181 pressure-sensor and E191 pressure-control failures; serious faults also flash hood LEDs. Stop cooking on alarm or lost capture, retain ventilation if available, and repair/recommission before cooking resumes.
failureResponseComparison.unearnedDetectability: An open hood contact wire can silently leave the kitchen supply at16 while mechanical extract is48. Unit RPM and upstream duct pressure do not measure that branch loss. Hood LEDs alone are not a proven warning for every loss.
failureResponseComparison.decision: Conventional visible warning plus manual stop remains preferable to an automatic hob interlock if every relevant failure is actually detected. A local branch-flow indication/comparison or native qualified equivalent is still required before this manual contract is admitted; no universal automated inhibit requirement is invented.
